title: Added deterministic ROIC screening and removed unpriced tickers from served coverage
points: Added a deterministic ROIC screen that ranks operating companies from structured statement rows and shows NOPAT, invested capital, usable periods, and formula basis.
Added ROIC compute instructions so ROIC and return-on-invested-capital screens follow a fixed lane instead of broad language-model retrieval.
Removed tickers with no market-data closing price or market cap from the served ticker reference so price-dependent queries disclose unsupported coverage instead of failing late.
